title: Open module cohomology inverts local isomorphisms
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], U an open subset, and f:M -> N a morphism of sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose its restriction by the over-site functor overFunctor U is an isomorphism. Then for every p >= 0 the induced morphism H^p(U,M) -> H^p(U,N), using open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], is an isomorphism of additive groups. There are no compactness or coherence assumptions.

source.place: Tag 01E1, Lemma 20.7.1(1)-(2), locality of cohomology and its proof

proof.text: Choose injective resolutions I and J of M and N and the standard comparison cochain map phi lifting f. Obtain exactness of R = overFunctor U from open_restriction_adjunction_exact. Construct restricted resolutions explicitly, with cocomplex R(I), injective terms from restrict_injectiveResolution, and augmentation given by the inverse singleMapHomologicalComplex isomorphism followed by R(I.iota). Exactness makes the augmentations quasi-isomorphisms.

The module category on the over-site has enough injectives by the proved upstream SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian and the Mathlib Grothendieck enough-injectives instance. R(phi) lifts R(f): applying R to desc_commutes_zero verifies the augmentation equation. InjectiveResolution.iso_hom_naturality identifies the image of R(phi) in the homotopy category with the chosen injective-resolution image of the isomorphism R(f), conjugated by comparison isomorphisms. Thus its image is an isomorphism.

Let T be the additive functor of sections at the terminal object of Over U. Applying T on the homotopy category and then degree-p homology preserves the previous isomorphism. HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors transfers it to homology of the actual section complex. Sections at the terminal object after R are definitionally sections on U; their induced cochain maps are the same. Finally isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality identifies this homology map with openModuleCohomology.map f, conjugated by isomorphisms, and cancellation gives the result.

AddEquiv.ofBijective and its inverse laws construct the division once local cohomology bijectivity is established.

No duplicate local-isomorphism lemma. Mathlib InjectiveResolution.iso_hom_naturality and isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality, together with HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors, supply a complete proof. The proved upstream SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian supplies the over-site module-category instance without importing the stronger localized-generator statement.

theorem openModuleCohomology_map_isIso_of_overFunctor (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (U : Opens X) {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    [IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X) U).map f)] (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((openModuleCohomology X p U).map f)
